normalization: Frozen full ViT CLS+patchmean1536 FP32 L2. Kernel center/median-distance width from fixed base landmarks only; L2 and constant1 then /sqrt2
training_dtype: FP64 analytic moments and solve, FP32 frozen features
optimizer: No formal neural optimizer. GPU FP64 positive-definite normal equation solve; real qualification includes discarded head SGD/clip path.
initialization: Real distinct base-patient landmarks fixed before any later arrival; no later-class head init or future class data
objective: Class-equal(patient-equal(image-equal)) squared error +1e-4 ridge; natural kernel control weights classes by patient counts; linear balanced control same mass normalization
sampling: No SGD or replay sampling; every actually arriving image contributes to fixed-space patient-class moments, complete current descriptors discarded after independent online moment check
